title: LexiDet-OVD: Benchmarking Lexical Sensitivity in Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.29851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary object detectors localize objects from free-form text prompts, but their reliability depends on how users describe the target. Standard evaluations usually test a fixed class name, leaving prompt-induced failure modes underexplored. We introduce LexiDet-OVD, a benchmark and metric suite for studying lexical sensitivity in open-vocabulary object detection. We organize prompt sets into equivalent, conditional, and broad semantic scopes, and evaluate four detector families on fixed COCO and LVIS samples, each covering 30 classes (800 held-out COCO images and 1,000 LVIS images). Beyond mean and worst-prompt AP50, we report P10, CVaR at 20%, leave-one-prompt-out influence, detection agreement, box consistency, and confidence variance using one-to-one multi-instance matching. Equivalent-prompt best-to-worst gaps range from 5.3 to 23.4 points on COCO1000 and from 5.1 to 29.9 points on LVIS1000-30c, showing that strong average

translated_title: LexiDet-OVD：开放词汇目标检测中词汇敏感性的基准评测
translated_abstract: 开放词汇目标检测器可以根据自由形式的文本提示定位目标，但其可靠性取决于用户如何描述目标。标准评估通常只测试固定的类别名称，导致由提示措辞引发的失败模式鲜有被探索。我们提出了 LexiDet-OVD，这是一个用于研究开放词汇目标检测中词汇敏感性的基准与指标套件。我们将提示集合组织为等价、条件和宽泛三种语义范围，并在固定的 COCO 和 LVIS 样本上评估了四种检测器系列，每个样本覆盖 30 个类别（800 张留出的 COCO 图像和 1,000 张 LVIS 图像）。除了平均 AP50 和最差提示 AP50 之外，我们还通过一对一多实例匹配报告了 P10、20% 分位条件风险值（CVaR）、留一提示影响、检测一致性、边界框一致性和置信度方差。等价提示之间的最优与最差性能差距在 COCO1000 上为 5.3 至 23.4 个百分点，在 LVIS1000-30c 上为 5.1 至 29.9 个百分点，表明即使平均性能很强……
tldr: 提出 LexiDet-OVD 基准与指标套件，系统评测开放词汇目标检测器对提示词措辞（词汇敏感性）的脆弱性，发现等价提示间的性能差距最高可达约 30 个百分点。
en_tdlr: LexiDet-OVD introduces a benchmark and metric suite to systematically measure lexical sensitivity in open-vocabulary object detection, revealing best-to-worst performance gaps of up to ~30 points even across semantically equivalent prompts.
